item.title: MarketBeat Updates News Sentiment Scoring System for BioMarin
item.description:
MarketBeat Updates News Sentiment Scoring System for BioMarin

The latest update from MarketBeat adds new analytics to its news‑sentiment tracking, showing how BioMarin Pharmaceutical (BMRN) is covered in the press this week.

🔍 Overview

  • Extended trading is defined as trading on electronic markets outside regular hours.
  • A fair market value extended hours price is supplied by Massive.
  • MarketBeat tracks headlines from hundreds of trusted media outlets and tags each by company.

🧩 How It Works

  • Each headline receives a score from 2 (good news) to -2 (bad news).
  • The company news sentiment score reflects the average sentiment of articles about the company over the most recent 7 days.
  • A separate average healthcare news sentiment is also calculated.

🚀 Availability

  • Users can help via texting HELP and unsubscribe at any time by replying STOP or visiting the mailing preferences page.

💡 Why It Matters

  • The sentiment scores give investors a quick gauge of positive or negative press surrounding a company.
  • Comparing the weekly article count to the average week highlights changes in media attention.

item.title: MarketBeat Updates Company News Sentiment Scores for Simulations Plus, AMZE, and UNF
item.description:
MarketBeat Updates Company News Sentiment Scores for Simulations Plus, AMZE, and UNF

MarketBeat has refreshed its weekly company news sentiment metrics, adding the latest sentiment scores, article counts, and engagement data for three listed firms.

🔍 Overview

  • MarketBeat assigns each news headline a sentiment score from -2 (bad news) to +2 (good news).
  • The platform aggregates these scores across all headlines mentioning a company to produce a 7‑day average news sentiment.
  • Tracking is performed across hundreds of trusted media outlets in real time, with headlines tagged by company.

🧩 How it works

  • Score assignment – Every headline is evaluated and given a numeric score within the –2 to +2 range.
  • Sentiment aggregation – Scores are averaged over the most recent seven days to create a company‑level sentiment metric.
  • Article tagging – News articles are automatically tagged to the relevant company, enabling per‑company tracking.
  • Coverage comparison – The system compares the number of articles published in the last seven days to a typical week for each company.

item.title: MarketBeat launches company news sentiment scoring system
item.description:
MarketBeat launches company news sentiment scoring system

MarketBeat has introduced a sentiment scoring system that assigns a numeric rating to each news headline and aggregates those ratings into company‑level sentiment scores.

🔍 Overview

  • Each headline receives a score ranging from 2 (good news) to -2 (bad news).
  • Scores are averaged over the most recent 7 days to produce a company news sentiment score.
  • The system tracks headlines from hundreds of news outlets and tags them by company.

⚙️ How it works

  • Headlines are collected in real time from more than one hundred trusted media outlets.
  • A numeric score is assigned to each headline according to its perceived tone.
  • The platform calculates the average sentiment for each company based on the scores from the last seven days.
  • A separate chart compares the number of articles about a company in the last seven days with the average weekly article count.

📊 Current sentiment highlights

  • PRHI News Sentiment: ▼ 0.88

  • Users can subscribe via the website or receive SMS alerts (available in multiple countries) that include stock alerts, news stories, and partner offers.
